svg.title: Qwen3.8 processor-expanded visual tokens by frame format
svg.desc: A log-scale paired scatter compares contact-sheet and native-video visual tokens for 2,062 held-out trajectories. A second panel reports the ratio-of-sums token reduction for Corpus A, Corpus B, and both corpora pooled.
